title: optimset
summary: Create or update optimization options structures with MATLAB-compatible name/value handling.

gpu_support.notes: Options are host metadata. Automatically resident payloads gather transparently; preserving explicit gpuArray payloads is a gated RunMat extension.

description: `optimset` builds option structs for optimization routines and supports MATLAB-compatible create-from-scratch and copy-and-override workflows with recognized option names.
behaviors: Option names are case-insensitive for the builtins that consume them.
`TolX`, `TolFun`, `MaxIter`, `MaxFunEvals`, `Display`, `Algorithm`, and `SpecifyObjectiveGradient` are canonicalized when constructed with `optimset`.
`GradObj` is accepted as a MATLAB-compatible alias for `SpecifyObjectiveGradient`.
Documented numeric option values use single or double. Native integer payloads are a gated RunMat extension and remain exact in the returned struct without a compatibility mirror.
Automatically resident payloads gather into host metadata. Explicitly resident payloads are rejected in compatibility mode and preserved only when RunMat extensions are enabled.
Unknown option names are preserved so future solvers can read them.

examples.input:
opts = optimset('TolX', 1e-10, 'Display', 'off');
x = fminbnd(@cos, 0, pi, opts)
